clue.text: Prepare to be uncomfortable appearing for trial

parts.note: to be warm is to be in an awkward or uncomfortable spot, as when things are made warm for someone
someone up before the court is appearing for trial

explanation.surface: Someone braces for an unpleasant time as they face a court hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: To loosen up before exercise or a performance is to get ready for it, a verb sense of prepare.

clue.text: Common excuse of a learner not quite at the same place in book

parts.note: L is for learner, as on a learner driver's plate

indicators.note: not quite tells us the last letter of the reference word is cut off

parts.words: at the same place in book
parts.note: ibid, short for ibidem, refers to the same place in a book

explanation.surface: A student's usual excuse is not quite up to the book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not quite' removes the D from IBID, giving IBI.
explanation.definitionFit: A claim to have been elsewhere is the standard plea for innocence.

clue.text: Gun taken to make marriage secure?

parts.note: a match is a marriage
to lock is to secure

explanation.surface: A shotgun is used to make sure a wedding happens.
explanation.definitionFit: An old firearm fired by a slow match is a type of musket, so a gun.

clue.text: Pinhole, originally, to shoot, somehow, these

definitions.text: Pinhole, originally, to shoot, somehow, these

indicators.note: originally points to the beginning of the word Pinhole, its first letter
somehow means in some unspecified way, so the letters of shoot are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pinhole camera is used to take pictures.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: a pinhole camera shoots pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: Pictures taken with a camera are what a pinhole camera is used to shoot.

clue.text: Tranquilizing half-dose given to case in school

indicators.note: only the latter half of the word dose is wanted here, its final two letters

parts.note: the dative is a grammatical case taught in school Latin or German lessons

explanation.surface: A pupil's sickness case is given half the usual dose of a calming drug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half' takes SE, the second half of 'dose'; 'given to' simply joins it to DATIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: A drug that calms the nerves is tranquilizing, and the adjective describing such a drug is the same.

clue.text: This office device can impale things, when manipulated

indicators.note: manipulated means handled and moved around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A desktop gadget that pierces things when you use it.
explanation.definitionFit: A stapler is a common piece of office equipment.

clue.text: Uninteresting detail in engraving

parts.note: something dry is dull and uninteresting
a point is a detail or item

explanation.surface: An uninteresting detail in an engraving.
explanation.definitionFit: An intaglio technique using a needle on copper is a form of engraving.

clue.text: Fish for five in well-known bars

definitions.meaning: Schubert's famous quintet, a piece for five players, is named after this fish

explanation.surface: A fish served for five people in popular pubs.
explanation.definitionFit: A freshwater fish and the name of Schubert's well-known piece for five players.

clue.text: Lightweight packed case put on board

definitions.text: Lightweight packed case put on board

parts.words: Lightweight packed case put on board
parts.note: a light puff-pastry shell that is filled and served on the table

explanation.surface: A lightweight suitcase is loaded aboard a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A light pastry shell is filled with a savoury mixture and served at table.

clue.text: Brewer, for example, has a way of speaking a line

parts.note: diction is a manner of enunciating words
RY, for railway, is a common abbreviation for a line

explanation.surface: A beer maker has a particular accent when delivering a line.
explanation.walkthrough: Brewer's Dictionary of Phrase and Fable is a famous reference book, so the 'Brewer' is not a beer maker.
explanation.definitionFit: Brewer's is a well-known reference book of phrases, an example of a lexicon.

clue.text: Capital consisting of, mainly, loose change

indicators.note: change is read as a verb telling us to rearrange the letters before it
mainly means most of the word, so the final letter of loose is dropped

explanation.surface: Coins described as mostly loose change are part of some capital sum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mainly' trims LOOSE to LOOS, and 'change' rearranges those letters; 'consisting of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Norway's seat of government is a national capital city.

clue.text: Now light is dissipated, this creature may emerge

definitions.text: Now light is dissipated, this creature may emerge

indicators.note: dissipated means scattered, so the letters of the words before it are dispersed and regrouped

explanation.surface: Once daylight fades, a nocturnal animal comes out.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the anagram and a description of a bird that emerges as daylight goes.
explanation.definitionFit: A late-hours person or nocturnal bird comes out when daylight goes.

clue.text: Production ended by cast

parts.note: something finished or over is out
to cast a shot is to put it, as in shot put

explanation.surface: A theatre production finishes because of its actors.
explanation.definitionFit: Output is the amount produced, a synonym for production.

clue.text: Response from the choir

indicators.note: from tells us the letters are taken out of the run of words the choir

explanation.surface: A choir sings back an answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverberation is a sound's reply, so a reply or response.

clue.text: One helping to make jam — sour faced person over cooker, say

indicators.note: over in a down clue means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: a crab is a bad-tempered, sour person
a cooking apple is called a cooker

explanation.surface: A grumpy person stands over the stove helping to make jam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooker' is not a stove but a cooking apple.
explanation.definitionFit: A small sour wild fruit is used to make jelly and jam.

clue.text: Decade of Einstein's development?

indicators.note: development suggests something growing and changing shape, so the name's letters are reworked

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Which ten years saw the great physicist's progress?
explanation.definitionFit: The 1990s or 1890s is a period of ten years, a decade.

clue.text: It overturns visible embarrassment and fatigue

indicators.note: overturns tells us the word It is turned upside down in this down clue

parts.note: taken as written
redness is the blush of embarrassment

explanation.surface: A blush and exhaustion overcome someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Weariness is another word for fatigue.

clue.text: Enormous deficit in solid fuel

indicators.note: in tells us the deficit sits inside the fuel

parts.note: coal is a solid fuel
a loss is a deficit

explanation.surface: A huge financial deficit in the solid fuel industry.
explanation.definitionFit: Colossal means huge or enormous.

clue.text: Where light control enables positive developments to occur

definitions.text: Where light control enables positive developments to occur

parts.words: Where light control enables positive developments to occur
parts.note: read photographically: a sealed room where light is controlled so that film can be developed into positive prints

explanation.surface: A place of careful lighting fosters good progress.
explanation.definitionFit: Photographers develop prints in a light-sealed room, making positives from negatives.

clue.text: Compassion no longer for a baseball player

definitions.meaning: an archaic word for pity, now obsolete
Babe ... was a famous American baseball star

explanation.surface: Pity is gone for a ballplayer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruth is an old word for pity, and Babe Ruth was the celebrated slugger.

clue.text: Character in grease-paint

explanation.surface: Acting a role in stage makeup.
explanation.definitionFit: Make-up is both one's nature and theatrical cosmetics.

clue.text: Man up in Argentina takes a cough mixture

indicators.note: a cough mixture is medicine, but mixture also tells us to mix the letters

explanation.surface: A man in the Argentine highlands takes cough medicine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' means up country, out in the pampas, not in the town.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowboy of the South American pampas is a man found out in the country in Argentina.

clue.text: Bonnie partner for the flower of Scotland

definitions.meaning: a flower is a river, something that flows, and this is Glasgow's river

explanation.surface: A fine Scottish girl's partner and Scotland's flower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' is read as one that flows, a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Clyde Barrow robbed banks with Bonnie Parker, and the river flows through Glasgow.

clue.text: Thriller-writer whose creations are snuffed out?

definitions.meaning: a candle maker makes candles that are snuffed out

explanation.surface: A crime novelist whose characters keep getting killed off.
explanation.definitionFit: Raymond Chandler wrote crime fiction, and a chandler is a candle maker.

clue.text: Choose prince, having no indication of alternatives

indicators.note: having no tells us a piece is removed from the prince

parts.note: an elector was a German prince entitled to choose the emperor
the word or indicates alternatives

explanation.surface: Choose a prince without any alternatives.
explanation.definitionFit: To elect is to choose by vote.

clue.text: Nimble mole spotted around river

indicators.note: around tells us the first piece encloses the second

parts.note: a mole is a secret agent, a spy

explanation.surface: A quick little mole is seen near a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mole' is an infiltrating agent, not the burrowing animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Spry means agile and lively, a synonym of nimble.

clue.text: The heat in Berkshire, for example?

definitions.text: The heat in Berkshire, for example?

parts.words: The heat in Berkshire, for example?
parts.note: a Berkshire is a breed of pig, so its heat is a pig's fever, a temperature in a hog

explanation.surface: A hot spell in an English county.
explanation.walkthrough: Berkshire is an English county, but also a breed of pig.
explanation.definitionFit: A pig disease brings a high temperature, and the Berkshire is a pig breed.

clue.text: Signal the start of military rising

definitions.text: Signal the start of military rising

parts.words: Signal the start of military rising
parts.note: the bugle call that wakes soldiers at dawn and starts their day

explanation.surface: The sign that an army revolt has begun.
explanation.definitionFit: A bugle call wakes troops in the morning, signalling them to get up.

clue.text: Spanish tender vegetable to prepare inside

indicators.note: inside tells us one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a pea is a vegetable
to set a table is to prepare it

explanation.surface: A Spanish cook prepares a tender vegetable dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tender' is legal tender, money, not soft food.
explanation.definitionFit: The former currency of Spain was legal tender there.
